jobs.title: Associate Director, Technology Enablement
jobs.description:
The Klick Group—comprising Klick Health (including Klick Katalyst and btwelve), Klick Media Group, Klick Applied Sciences (including Klick Labs), Klick Consulting, and Klick Ventures—is an ecosystem dedicated to realizing the full potential of our people and clients in life sciences. Founded in 1997, we have offices in New York, Philadelphia, Saratoga Springs, Toronto, London, São Paulo, and Singapore. Consistently named a Best Managed Company, Most Admired Corporate Culture, and Great Place to Work, Klick is committed to fostering a high-performance, people-first culture with creativity, collaboration, innovation, and impact across everything we do.

About Our Technology Craft

Our Technology craft brings together delivery specialists, architects, engineers, and platform experts who design and implement solutions that help healthcare brands connect with patients and professionals. We focus on delivering scalable, compliant, and user-centered technology across web, CRM, data, and engagement platforms while partnering closely with PMO and cross-functional teams to support consistent, high-quality delivery.

Job Description

This role guides the delivery of complex technology solutions across web, CRM, and omnichannel ecosystems. The Associate Director acts as a bridge between technology and delivery teams, ensuring projects are planned, executed, and launched with clarity, quality, and operational consistency. The role partners across technology crafts, PMO, and client teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions that support healthcare brands and their audiences.

What You’ll Do:

Lead day-to-day delivery across multiple technology projects, ensuring alignment on timelines, scope, and budget.
Drive consistency and quality across all delivery phases, including planning, build, testing, and launch.
Define technical task plans and collaborate with PMO on project scheduling, dependencies, and resourcing.
Review requirements and technical documentation to ensure clarity, feasibility, and completeness.
Partner with teams to track risks, manage delivery challenges, and support scalable, compliant technical solutions.

Qualifications

Required:

7+ years delivering web, CRM, or omnichannel technology solutions, ideally in healthcare or regulated industries
Experience managing cross-functional technology teams and multiple concurrent workstreams
Ability to interpret and communicate technical requirements, documentation, and design assets
Strong collaboration skills across creative, strategy, and technology partners, including client-facing discussions
Familiarity with web and CRM platforms such as Veeva, Salesforce, Adobe Experience Manager, or Contentful
Ability to stay organized, adapt to changing priorities, and maintain focus in a fast-paced environment

Desired:

Experience supporting pharma marketing or medical-affairs programs
Background as a business systems analyst
Knowledge of healthcare compliance, privacy, or FDA-related standards
Experience in technology consulting or omnichannel program delivery
Familiarity with healthcare data standards or marketing-operations workflows
Experience integrating AI tools into daily or project-based work

Additional Information

The base salary range for this position is between CAD $110,000 - $130,000. The final amount offered will be determined based on several factors such as a candidate's work location, their unique skill set, education, and prior work experience. This posting is for an existing vacancy at Klick.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Klick is consciously creating a culture where everyone can thrive and grow in their careers. We believe that our best work comes from our diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We strongly encourage members of historically underrepresented communities to apply, including Black people, Indigenous peoples, and other people of color, people with disabilities, people from gender and sexually diverse communities and people with intersectional identities. We're also committed to developing an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. Should you require any accommodation, please contact us at careers@klick.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs and ensure you have a positive experience.

jobs.title: Assistant Director - EY wavespace - Strategy & Innovation
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

As an Assistant Director, you will play a pivotal role in Canada’s EY wavespace and CX team, working with some of our most forward-thinking clients as they navigate complex business challenges and opportunities. You will work at the forefront of their transformation and AI agendas, helping to shape priorities and influence strategic direction.

Leveraging EY’s design thinking-based wavespace methodology, you will design and facilitate collaborative client sessions that foster alignment, generate innovative ideas, and enable informed strategic decision-making. You will play a key role in high-impact client projects and initiatives, bringing together diverse stakeholders to co-create solutions, shape innovation and transformation agendas, and deliver meaningful, actionable outcomes.

Through the global EY wavespace network, you will tap into leading practices, insights, and capabilities to deliver exceptional and differentiated client experiences. Learn more about EY wavespace here: EY wavespace

In addition, as part of our overarching CX strategy that includes a client listening program, you will have the opportunity to engage directly with senior executives, transforming their feedback into actionable insights that strengthen relationships and drive continuous improvement across client experiences.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

Your Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end EY wavespace experiences, including:

Driving discovery phases to ensure an in depth understanding of clients’ current situation and future vision through interviews and/or review of strategic plans
Designing, preparing and executing immersive innovation sessions where you will:
Partner with clients to co-design the approach for the session
Identify and bring forward internal and/or external thought leaders, case studies and examples to inspire new perspectives
Synthesize and bring forward relevant insights from client discovery phase
Facilitate design-thinking based ideation and prioritization sessions to draw out innovative, value-generating opportunities
Build alignment across stakeholders to develop clear, actionable strategic roadmaps and plans
Leverage your creative ingenuity and our digital collaboration technologies to create exceptional and unique immersive experiences with our clients

Collaborating with EY account teams to debrief insights from EY wavespace engagements and client experience activities, helping to identify opportunities for continued value creation

Support and advance our client experience approach, including:

Meeting with clients from across industries to capture and synthesize their feedback on their experiences with EY
Assist in transforming perspectives into actionable insights and recommendations that strengthen relationships, enhance future engagements, and support opportunity development

Skills And Attributes For Success

Strong executive presence, with the confidence to engage and present at all levels
Excellent communication skills (oral and written), with the ability to deliver clear, concise, and impactful messages
Proven ability to build trusted relationships and collaborate effectively across teams and stakeholders
Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes
Demonstrated critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex challenges into practical, actionable solutions
High emotional intelligence, cultural awareness, and ability to quickly establish credibility with clients and teams
Curiosity and adaptability, with comfort in navigating ambiguity and continuously learning
Strong understanding of digital trends and disruptions shaping client business landscapes
Commitment to delivering exceptional client experiences and coaching high-performing teams

To qualify for the role, you should have:

5-7 years of management consulting or equivalent business transformation or corporate strategy experience
Demonstrated project management skills
Expertise in design thinking tools and methods
This role involves interaction with clients operating nationally and globally where fluency in French and English is required. Bilingualism in both French and English is therefore a requirement of this role

Ideally, you’ll also have

Interest and comfort in leveraging AI tools to support ideation, research and session delivery
MBA or equivalent Master’s degree

What We Offer You

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package allows you decide which benefits are right for you and which ones help you create a solid foundation for your future. Our Total Rewards package includes a discretionary bonus program, a comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage plan, a defined contribution pension plan, a great vacation policy plus firm paid days that allow you to enjoy longer long weekends throughout the year, statutory holidays and paid personal days (based on province of residence), and a range of exciting programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry
Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any accommodations you may need.

Inclusiveness at EY

Inclusiveness is at the heart of who we are and how we work. We’re committed to fostering an environment where differences are valued, policies and practices are equitable, and our people feel a sense of belonging. We embrace diversity and are committed to combating systemic racism, advancing gender equity and women in leadership, advocating for the 2SLGBTQIA+ community, promoting our neuroinclusion and accessibility initiatives, and are dedicated to amplifying the voices of Indigenous peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis) nationally as we strive towards reconciliation. Our diverse experiences, abilities, backgrounds, and perspectives make our people unique and help guide us. Because when people feel free to be their authentic selves at work, they bring their best and are empowered to build a better working world.

Learn about our commitment to Inclusiveness at https://www.ey.com/en_ca/about-us/corporate-responsibility/equity

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

At EY, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools as one element of our recruitment process to enhance efficiency and improve the candidate experience. While AI supports us in our process, human judgment and decision-making remain integral in our candidate experience. We are committed to the responsible use of AI, and our practices are continuously reviewed and refined to ensure they align with ethical principles and regulatory requirements.

To all recruitment agencies: EY does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. Any resumes submitted without a prior agreement or request from our hiring team will not be considered. EY is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
